blocks.text: **хороший** — **лучше** — **лучший**; **плохой** — **хуже** — **худший**; **большой** — **больше** — **больший**; **маленький** — **меньше** — **меньший**. The forms "**лучший**" and "**худший**" are used as modifiers and are declined like regular adjectives.
"**старее**" and "**более старый**" are comparative forms from "**старый**". They mean "older" mainly as the opposite of "newer".

"**старше**" and "**старший**", however, mean "older" in age or "senior" in rank: *Мой брат старше меня на два года.* The forms "**моложе**" and "**более молодой**" mean "younger" in age, while "**младше**" and "**младший**" may mean either younger in age or junior in rank.
From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 80–82.
Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Вам придётся копнуть ___ (глубокий), если хотите дойти до правды.
exercises.prompt: You're going to have to delve deeper if you want to get to the truth.
exercises.why: **глубокий → поглубже** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.

exercises.prompt: It is better to take care of it early.
exercises.why: **хороший → лучше** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.

exercises.prompt: This side of the street is less well lit.
exercises.why: **плохой → хуже** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.

exercises.prompt: My dad used to drive a Beetle.
exercises.why: **ранний → раньше** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.

exercises.prompt: Ravens are said to live much longer than humans.
exercises.why: **долгий → дольше** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.

exercises.prompt: The stomach is easier satisfied than the eye.
exercises.why: **лёгкий → легче** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.

exercises.prompt: The date will be determined later.
exercises.why: **поздний → позже** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.

exercises.prompt: Quiet! You'll scare the fish away.
exercises.why: **тихий → Тише** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.

exercises.prompt: Please don't boil the eggs so hard.
exercises.why: **жидкий → пожиже** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.

exercises.prompt: Today, it's much hotter.
exercises.why: **жаркий → жарче** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.

exercises.prompt: I can't swim any further.
exercises.why: **большой → больше** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.

exercises.prompt: It would cost twice as much as that.
exercises.why: **дорогой → дороже** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.

exercises.q: Когда прошёл дождь и почва сырая, становится ___ (простой) полоть сорняки.
exercises.prompt: When rain's fallen and the soil is moist, it becomes easier to pull out weeds.
exercises.why: **простой → проще** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.

exercises.q: Том, возможно, всего на год-два ___ (молодой) Мэри.
exercises.prompt: Tom is probably just a year or two younger than Mary.
exercises.why: **два моложе** — 2–4, 22–24, 32–34… (not 12–14) take the genitive singular (молодой → моложе).

exercises.prompt: My cousin is a little older than I.
exercises.why: **старший → старше** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.

exercises.prompt: This hat is less expensive than that one.
exercises.why: **дешёвый → дешевле** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.

exercises.prompt: Nothing is as hard as a diamond.
exercises.why: **твёрдый → твёрже** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.

exercises.q: У господина Янга не ___ (маленький) шести машин.
exercises.prompt: Mr Young has no less than six cars.
exercises.why: **маленький → меньше** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.

exercises.prompt: Takada is the richest out of all of us.
exercises.why: **богатый → богаче** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.

exercises.q: Я стараюсь держаться ___ (далёкий) от политики и её неадекватностей.
exercises.prompt: I am trying to distance myself from politics and its inadequacies.
exercises.why: **далёкий → подальше** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.
